context: A teacher and student discuss an international film
purpose: Teach: 中山/日系/白人/ロバート/リチャード/ルイス/フランク/アブ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨日の映画、主演のロバートさん、好演でしたね。
lines.en: Yesterday's film — Robert in the lead role was really well cast.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Genuine appreciation in the tone. Natural pause after the dash. Unhurried, like sharing something worth noticing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。脇役のリチャードとルイス、舞台俳優出身で味があります。
lines.en: Yes. Richard and Lewis in the supporting roles — both stage actors, which gave those parts real depth.
lines.style: Quiet agreement that builds slightly. Thoughtful cadence. A small lift on the names, showing he's been thinking about this. Genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: フランクの撮影監督、白人だけでなく、日系の出演者も主役級に扱う構成、印象的でした。
lines.en: The cinematography was striking — how Frank framed not just the white actors but the Japanese-descent cast members as leads too.
lines.style: Engaged, leaning forward slightly in the voice. Deliberate emphasis on the observation itself. Mid-pace, clear. The kind of comment that shows you've been paying close attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 中山さんの撮影助手も、舞台裏で評価が高いと聞きました。
lines.en: I've heard Nakayama-san, the camera assistant, gets a lot of quiet praise from the crew behind the scenes.
lines.style: Probing gently, curious tone. Soft delivery, like he's testing whether she'd noticed that layer too. Not interrogating — offering information to see if she has more.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 撮影地の野外、アブが多くて大変だったそうですよ。
lines.en: The outdoor shooting locations had so many horseflies — apparently it was quite rough on set.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. A gentle laugh underneath — shared acknowledgment of the unglamorous reality. Fades slightly at the end, completing the thought quietly.
